independent_outcomes: The pre-wave carry holds a finished prerequisite whenever its branch tip differs from the PR head it judged clean, so the commit that was never reviewed stays off the line, and its dependents are held with one named reason.
proposed_seams: None proposed. The brief describes one defect with one check: compare the carry's judged head with the branch tip in the same fetched checkout, and hold on mismatch. The three success-criterion cases (merged then pushed, open with a stale head, unchanged clean case) all run through that one comparison and one not-clean path, so splitting them would give three PRs that each need the same new check.

If the human still wants two PRs, the only natural cut is the merged-PR case (criterion 1) versus the open-PR stale-read case (criterion 2). Both use the same code path, so this cut would duplicate work and is not recommended.
